CustomField.description: Lets ADHA_ReservationPaymentBatch release a reservation whose additional amount is unpaid three months after confirmation. Off, because nothing yet writes Additional_Payment_Received_On__c, so with it on the job releases every villa carrying an additional amount whether or not the customer has paid. Turn on only once payment receipting exists. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Payment Release Enabled
